note: P4398 (Pro 31:26) — she opens her mouth with wisdom; the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.

dims.v: wisdom — the wisdom with which she opens her mouth
the wisdom with which the excellent wife opens her mouth — speech governed by wisdom, so that what she says is sound and worth hearing, wisdom shaping her words as it shapes her deeds
welded to the loving instruction her tongue carries
chokmah (wisdom) — 'she opens her mouth with WISDOM' (31:26); her speech, like her work, is governed by wisdom. She speaks not idly but with sense, her words carrying weight and worth.
gracious instruction — the 'law of kindness' on her tongue
the teaching of kindness ('torat chesed') on her tongue — the gracious, loving instruction that colours her speech, so that her wisdom is spoken with kindness and her counsel is loyal love made word
welded to the wise speech it graces

chesed (kindness/steadfast love) — 'and the teaching of KINDNESS is on her tongue' (31:26); the 'law of kindness' governs her speech — her wisdom is spoken graciously, her instruction warm with steadfast love. Wisdom and kindness meet on her lips (cf 15:1; 16:24).
